title: Native test execution cannot supervise a child process
observed_need: Run the current MNCS compiler/runtime, enforce a wall-clock timeout, capture stdout/stderr, and preserve the child exit status.
current_language_behavior: MNCS has no process-spawn, subprocess-capture, environment, signal, or wall-clock timeout primitive at the external-consumer boundary.
why_insufficient: A native test framework cannot yet launch and supervise the compiler it is meant to consume without a host process adapter.
desired_direction: A bounded, capability-controlled runtime/tooling process-session API with explicit stdout/stderr, exit status, timeout, cancellation, and provenance semantics.
workaround: Python stdlib subprocess.run is used only to launch the external mncs executable, capture streams, and enforce the timeout; it does not evaluate tests.
